predictions.name: previous selects t-1
predictions.statement: substituting the token at t-1 changes the previous-token head's write at t more than substituting it at t-2 or t-4

predictions.name: induction selects j, j+1
predictions.statement: substituting the token at j or j+1 changes the induction head's write at t more than substituting it at j-2 or j+3

predictions.name: induction key reads previous
predictions.statement: the previous-token head's write from another passage in the induction head's key read lowers its attention to j+1 more than in its query read

predictions.name: induction writes next
predictions.statement: the induction head's read set to zero at t lowers log p(x_{j+1}) at t more than at t-5

predictions.name: copy value reads induction
predictions.statement: the induction head's write from another passage in the copy head's value read changes its write at t more than in its query read

predictions.name: copy writes next
predictions.statement: the copy head's read set to zero at t lowers log p(x_{j+1}) at t more than at t-5
